label: end-of-episode D1 after a common a2 trial, switching to a1 (very sparse)
explanation: Extremely sparse (33 dev steps in 27 episodes). It fires only at D1, only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (all dev activations at ep_trial 90-99, value-head output in its lowest bin), and only after a previous trial of a2 -> S2 common (100% of mass). It never fires at GO or D2. The strongest activations are D1 after a common unrewarded a2 trial where the agent then switches to a1. The recorded predicate uses the upcoming choice (action at D1), which the agent computes itself; it is not a future random outcome. Without the choice term, (D1, prev a2 common, ep_trial>=97) keeps 98% of mass, but precision is only about 1%. With the choice term, dev precision is 0.12, recall 0.61, F1 0.20. Most matching steps stay inactive, so no observed variable we checked explains when it fires. Magnitude is larger after unrewarded prev trials and on the final trial (ep_trial 99), but this rests on very few examples.
